description: Variation of condition 01 to Ref: 25/03859/VAR to allow an extension to the time limited permission to January 2027. (AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
decision_conditions: This permission is for a limited period, expiring on 10th January 2027, after which time the use hereby permitted shall be discontinued.  The structures installed and works carried out under this permission shall be removed and the land returned to its previous state.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:BWD063-PL-010/B Site Location PlanBWD063-PL-100/A Existing Site Layout - Ground Floor LevelBWD063-PL-101/A Existing Site Layout - First Floor LevelBWD063-PL-102/A Existing Site Layout - Second Floor LevelBWD063-PL-103/A Existing Site Layout - Roof LevelBWD063-PL-200/E Proposed Site Layout - Ground Floor LevelBWD063-PL-201/B Proposed Site Layout - First Floor LevelBWD063-PL-202/B Proposed Site Layout - Second Floor LevelBWD063-PL-203/A Proposed Site Layout - Roof LevelBWD063-PL-400/A Existing Elevations Sheet 1 of 2BWD063-PL-401/A Existing Elevations Sheet 2 of 2BWD063-PL-410/B Proposed Elevations Sheet 1 of 2BWD063-PL-411/C Proposed Elevations Sheet 2 of 22142-03 Rev C. Any events held indoors shall not operate outside the hours of 08:00am and 03:00am. Any events held outdoors shall not operate outside the hours of 09:00 and 22:30. Reason: To ensure no undue impacts on transport and road network and neighbouring amenity.

The development hereby approved shall be used as a creative and cultural venue only for the following functions:o	Filming and TV studio useo	Performance and rehearsal space for theatre and the artso	Corporate and brand eventso	Exhibitions for arts and cultural/ creative useso	Food and Drink eventso	Community eventso	Live music eventsThe development is not to be used for any other purpose, including within any Class of the of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 as amended September 2020 (or any equivalent class in any order that may replace it), or any use for which no class is specified in Paragraph 3 (6) of the Use Classes Order and which is not listed above.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and because highway and other impacts have been assessed onthe basis of the above quantum of development in accordance with policies D2 and D3 of the NewLondon Plan (2021) and CP1 and CP2 of Enfield's Core Strategy (2010).

No single event, or any simultaneously held combination of events, shall be attended by more than 14,999 occupants, including visitors and staff at any given time. Reason: To ensure there are no undue impacts on the transport and road network and protect neighbouring amenity.
The bicycle parking shall be provided in accordance with drawing (BWD063-PL-200/E).	Reason: To comply with Policy T5 of the London Plan.
